GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0

gsap.min.js and ScrollTrigger.min.js are copied unchanged from the npm package gsap@3.15.0 (dist/).
They are not covered by this repository's Apache License 2.0: they are Copyright GreenSock and are
used under the GSAP Standard License, https://gsap.com/standard-license.

The site works without them: they only add the scroll effects of site.js.
